Confine each job's commit to the paths it owns.

title: [bug] Config reconciler overwrites settings.yaml with stale stored state, no divergence guard for modules it does not own
description: P1 on tenant northwind/eu-west (a1b2c3d4), ticket 7e6f5d4c. Every pass of the billing_rollup_invoices step, scheduler nightly_job_scheduler_org, commits 'Refresh billing rollup config' and rewrites modules outside its boundary from a STALE snapshot. The rate-limit pin on the gateway module was deleted five times, once 14 seconds after the platform's own update_module_settings write. Needs a divergence guard: never overwrite with a snapshot older than the newest committed write. Ownership lives in .owned-paths.json.
